
## Building & Running

```bash
cargo build --release
./target/release/ollama_monitor
```

## Systemd Service Deployment

To run `ollama_monitor` as a persistent background service:

### 1. Install the binary and config

Copy the release binary and your config file to standard locations:

```bash
sudo cp ./target/release/ollama_monitor /usr/local/bin/
sudo cp config.toml /etc/ollama_monitor/
sudo chown root:root /usr/local/bin/ollama_monitor /etc/ollama_monitor/config.toml
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/ollama_monitor
sudo chmod 644 /etc/ollama_monitor/config.toml
```

### 2. Create a systemd service unit

Create `/etc/systemd/system/ollama_monitor.service`:

```ini
[Unit]
Description=Ollama Monitor
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/ollama_monitor
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
Environment=RUST_LOG=info
# Uncomment the next line if RUST_LOG is not set in config.toml:
# Environment=ENV_LOG_FILE=/var/log/ollama_monitor.log
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
User=root
Group=root

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

### 3. Enable and start the service

```bash
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable ollama_monitor
sudo systemctl start ollama_monitor
```

### Useful management commands

```bash
# Check service status
sudo systemctl status ollama_monitor

# View logs
sudo journalctl -u ollama_monitor -f

# Restart after config or binary changes
sudo systemctl restart ollama_monitor

# Stop and disable
sudo systemctl stop ollama_monitor
sudo systemctl disable ollama_monitor
```

jobs:
  # ── 1. Test with coverage ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  test:
    name: Run Tests with Coverage
    runs-on: arc-runner-larderly

      - name: Install required packages

          # Note: libssl-dev is intentionally omitted — this project uses rustls
          # everywhere and must not introduce openssl as a dependency.

      - name: Create test database

      - name: Install cargo-llvm-cov

      - name: Run migrations

      - name: Run all tests with coverage
        run: |
